name: retention-change
title: Retention Change
description: Retention picker that states what a shorter period deletes and when ("deletes 14,210 events older than 13 Sep, tonight at 02:00"), shades the doomed days on a chart, counts down while undoing is still free, and labels confirm "Delete without export" until exported.

meta.stops: Shorter retention purged months of data
meta.summary: Says exactly what a shorter data-retention period will delete and when, and suggests an export before it purges.
meta.server: Apply the new retention server-side with its own grace period, and make the purge job re-check the setting before deleting.
catches: Record count and cutoff date a shorter period would delete
Roughly how many more records go each night after
Window in which raising it back still loses nothing
Confirming without an export, named on the button
limits: Counts come from the daily history you pass; days are UTC calendar days
The chart is a summary (bars group days) and is hidden from screen readers; the text states the numbers
Does not delete or export anything itself
a11y: Options are native radios in a group labelled by the title
Deletion summary in a polite live region
Chart is aria-hidden; the same facts are in text
Export and save buttons set aria-busy while pending; icons are aria-hidden
